description: Depletion of DMD truncating variants in hemizygous males, restricted to variants that truncate the full-length muscle isoform Dp427m
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, requests
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

D=pd.read_csv("gnomad_v4_DMD_variants_flat.csv")
tx=requests.get("https://rest.ensembl.org/lookup/id/ENST00000357033?expand=1;content-type=application/json",timeout=120).json()
tr=tx["Translation"]; strand=tx["strand"]
ex=sorted(tx["Exon"],key=lambda e:e["start"],reverse=(strand==-1))
cum=0; rows=[]
for i,e in enumerate(ex,1):
    cs=max(e["start"],tr["start"]); ce=min(e["end"],tr["end"]); ov=max(0,ce-cs+1)
    rows.append(dict(rank=i,ex_start=e["start"],ex_end=e["end"],c_lo=cs,c_hi=ce,coding=ov,
                     cds_start=cum+1 if ov else np.nan,cds_end=cum+ov if ov else np.nan)); cum+=ov
EX=pd.DataFrame(rows); COD=EX[EX.coding>0]
def classify(p):
    inx=COD[(COD.c_lo<=p)&(COD.c_hi>=p)]
    if len(inx):
        r=inx.iloc[0]; off=(r.c_hi-p) if strand==-1 else (p-r.c_lo)
        return "coding_exon", int(r["rank"]), float(r.cds_start+off)
    # within 12 bp of a coding exon boundary -> canonical splice site
    d=np.minimum((COD.c_lo-p).abs(),(COD.c_hi-p).abs())
    if d.min()<=12:
        r=COD.loc[d.idxmin()]; return "canonical_splice_site", int(r["rank"]), float(r.cds_start)
    inex=EX[(EX.ex_start<=p)&(EX.ex_end>=p)]
    return ("UTR_of_canonical" if len(inex) else "intron_of_canonical"), (int(inex.iloc[0]["rank"]) if len(inex) else np.nan), np.nan

PLOF={"frameshift_variant","stop_gained","splice_acceptor_variant","splice_donor_variant"}
hc=D[(D.csq.isin(PLOF))&(D.lof=="HC")].copy()
hc["gpos"]=hc.variant_id.str.split("-").str[1].astype(int)
cl=hc.gpos.map(classify)
hc["region"]=[c[0] for c in cl]; hc["exon"]=[c[1] for c in cl]; hc["cds"]=[c[2] for c in cl]
hc["tolerated"]=hc.hemi>0
print("Where gnomAD HC-pLoF calls fall relative to the canonical muscle transcript ENST00000357033 (Dp427m):")
print(pd.crosstab(hc.region, hc.tolerated).rename(columns={False:"absent from males",True:"present in males"}).to_string())
hc.to_csv("gnomad_v4_DMD_HCpLoF_region_classified.csv",index=False)

print("\nRecurrent escapers (>=5 hemizygous males), region relative to Dp427m:")
print(hc[hc.hemi>=5].sort_values("hemi",ascending=False)[["variant_id","csq","hgvsc","tx","region","exon","ac","hemi"]].to_string(index=False))

# THE test, restricted to variants that genuinely truncate the full-length muscle isoform
mus=hc[hc.region.isin(["coding_exon","canonical_splice_site"])]
syn=D[D.csq=="synonymous_variant"]
a=int(mus.tolerated.sum()); b=len(mus)-a; c=int((syn.hemi>0).sum()); d=len(syn)-c
OR,p=stats.fisher_exact([[a,b],[c,d]]); se=np.sqrt(sum(1/max(x,.5) for x in (a,b,c,d)))
print("\n=== Depletion restricted to pLoF that truncate Dp427m (n=%d) ==="%len(mus))
print("  seen in >=1 hemizygous male: %d/%d = %.1f%%   vs synonymous %d/%d = %.1f%%"%(a,len(mus),100*a/len(mus),c,len(syn),100*c/len(syn)))
print("  OR=%.4g  95%% CI %.4g-%.4g  Fisher p=%.3g"%(OR,OR*np.exp(-1.96*se),OR*np.exp(1.96*se),p))
print("  max hemizygote count among Dp427m-truncating pLoF: %d"%mus.hemi.max())
print("  total hemizygotes across all Dp427m-truncating pLoF: %d (vs %d for the 5 recurrent non-Dp427m escapers)"
      %(int(mus.hemi.sum()), int(hc[(hc.hemi>=5)&(~hc.index.isin(mus.index))].hemi.sum())))
print("\n  Dp427m-truncating pLoF seen in males, by exon:")
print(mus[mus.tolerated].sort_values("hemi",ascending=False)[["variant_id","csq","exon","ac","hemi"]].to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(15,5.1))
ax=axes[0]
cats=["synonymous\n(n=%d)"%len(syn),"missense\n(n=%d)"%int((D.csq=='missense_variant').sum()),
      "HC pLoF,\nall calls\n(n=%d)"%len(hc),"HC pLoF truncating\nDp427m\n(n=%d)"%len(mus)]
vals=[100*(syn.hemi>0).mean(),100*(D[D.csq=='missense_variant'].hemi>0).mean(),100*hc.tolerated.mean(),100*mus.tolerated.mean()]
bars=ax.bar(cats,vals,color=["#4C72B0","#4C72B0","#C44E52","#7A2E32"])
for bb,v in zip(bars,vals): ax.text(bb.get_x()+bb.get_width()/2,v+1.3,f"{v:.1f}%",ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% of variants seen in >=1 hemizygous male"); ax.set_ylim(0,65)
ax.set_title("Truncating variants that hit full-length muscle dystrophin\nare nearly absent from males: OR %.3f (95%% CI %.3f-%.3f)"%(OR,OR*np.exp(-1.96*se),OR*np.exp(1.96*se)),fontsize=10)
ax=axes[1]
sub=hc[hc.hemi>=5].sort_values("hemi")
lab=[f"{r.csq.replace('_variant','').replace('_',' ')}\n{r.region.replace('_',' ')}" for _,r in sub.iterrows()]
colm=["#7A2E32" if r.region in ("coding_exon","canonical_splice_site") else "#4C72B0" for _,r in sub.iterrows()]
ax.barh(range(len(sub)),sub.hemi,color=colm)
ax.set_yticks(range(len(sub))); ax.set_yticklabels(lab,fontsize=8)
for i,(h,v) in enumerate(zip(sub.hemi,sub.variant_id)): ax.text(h+2,i,f"{int(h)} males",va="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("hemizygous males carrying the variant in gnomAD v4.1.0")
ax.set_title("Every recurrent truncating 'escaper' spares the\nfull-length muscle isoform or hits a dispensable exon",fontsize=10)
ax.set_xlim(0,175)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
